name: Caculater Margin
summary: This EA is a margin calculation utility that helps traders compute required margin for pending or potential trades before execution. It does not open any positions itself but serves as a pre-trade analysis tool for risk and margin assessment.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个保证金计算工具，帮助交易者在下单前计算所需保证金。它本身不开仓，而是作为交易前的风险和保证金评估辅助工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心功能是保证金计算，而非交易策略。它通过获取当前账户杠杆、合约规格和手数等参数，计算出开仓所需保证金。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不执行交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理方面，它提供仓位大小与保证金的换算关系，帮助用户在开仓前评估资金占用。资金管理方面，它允许用户输入预期手数和品种，返回所需保证金金额，从而辅助风控决策。整体而言，这是一个辅助决策工具，旨在降低因保证金不足导致的交易失败风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core function of this EA is margin calculation rather than a trading strategy. It computes required margin by retrieving account leverage, contract specifications, and lot size parameters. Entry conditions are not applicable since this tool does not execute trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. For position sizing, it provides conversion between lot size and margin requirement, helping users assess capital usage before opening positions. For money management, it allows users to input desired lot size and symbol, returning the required margin amount to support risk control decisions. Overall, this is a decision-support tool aimed at reducing the risk of trade failures due to insufficient margin.

parameters.description: 计算保证金所用的交易品种

pros: 在开仓前预知所需保证金，避免因保证金不足导致交易失败
界面简洁直观，操作方便，适合新手使用
帮助交易者更好地进行资金管理和仓位规划
pros_en: Pre-calculates required margin before opening positions, preventing trade failures due to insufficient margin
Simple and intuitive interface, easy to operate, suitable for beginners
Helps traders better manage capital and plan position sizes
cons: 仅提供保证金计算功能，功能单一，缺乏综合风控分析
未考虑点值和浮动盈亏对可用保证金的影响
没有与实际下单流程集成，用户需手动参考计算结果
cons_en: Only provides margin calculation, single-function, lacks comprehensive risk analysis
Does not account for pip value and floating P&L impact on available margin
Not integrated with actual order placement flow, users must manually reference the calculation results
improvements: 增加综合风控面板，整合保证金、点值、盈亏计算
集成一键下单功能，根据计算结果自动设置手数
improvements_en: Add a comprehensive risk control panel integrating margin, pip value, and P&L calculations
Integrate one-click order placement that automatically sets lot size based on calculation results

risk_points: 该工具本身不执行交易，无直接风险
用户可能过度依赖计算结果而忽略市场滑点和点差变化
risk_points_en: The tool itself does not execute trades, no direct risk
Users may over-rely on calculation results and ignore market slippage and spread changes
